verdict.rationale: Jitsu is a Segment-style event pipeline, so handling GDPR/CCPA deletion and suppression requests and forwarding them to destinations is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no user-deletion or suppression request feature and no mechanism for propagating such requests to connected destinations. Functions that filter events and an available DPA are adjacent building blocks or legal paperwork, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a privacy lead, I can process user deletion and suppression requests (GDPR/CCPA) and have them forwarded to connected destinations
